title: AccessMembershipStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of `access.membership.status_changed` version 1: a membership was disabled or enabled. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner, or `null` for a platform membership. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

status.description: The status after the change. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.
